Name: Pizza Margherita
ShortDescription: Classic Neapolitan pizza with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
FullDescription: A traditional Italian pizza symbolizing the Italian flag (red, white, green).
Ingredients: Pizza dough, tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, basil, olive oil

Name: Spaghetti Carbonara
FullDescription: Made with guanciale, egg yolks, and Pecorino Romano cheese. No heavy cream!
Ingredients: Spaghetti, guanciale/crispy bacon, egg yolks, Pecorino Romano, black pepper

Name: Lasagne alla Bolognese
ShortDescription: Rich layered pasta dish with meat ragù and bechamel.
FullDescription: Slow-cooked meat ragù sauce layered with creamy bechamel sauce and lasagna sheets.
Ingredients: Lasagna sheets, meat ragù, bechamel sauce, parmesan

Name: Tiramisù
FullDescription: Savoiardi ladyfingers dipped in strong espresso and layered with a rich mascarpone cream.
Ingredients: Ladyfinger biscuits, espresso, mascarpone cheese, eggs, sugar, cocoa powder

Name: Risotto alla Milanese
FullDescription: Aromatic and creamy rice dish given a vibrant color and unique flavor by saffron.
Ingredients: Arborio rice, saffron, broth, butter, parmesan, white wine
